mechanic.summary: Three lifeforce zones must be cleansed by players so the Avatar can consume them, but each soak reduces healing done and greatly increases physical damage taken.
mechanic.response: Assign damage dealers to one purple zone each; keep the tank and healer free of the corruption whenever possible.
